title: Walking animation is mirrored: walking right looks like walking left
details: (Owner, in chat, 2026-09-26) "THE WALKING ANIMATION IS INVERTED SO I LOOK LIKE IM WALKING LEFT WHEN IM WALKING RIGHT ... WE DONT HAVE ALL THE ANIMATION FRAMES". Cause found: tools/make-assets.js treats the LimeZu sheet's first block (which faces right) as "left", then world.js mirrors it for right.
